text: Multi-class EV charging and performance-based regulation service in a residential smart parking lot should be assessed against Kaal's source-bound claim that Although aggregate venture capital sector data arguably only confirms what media reporting already showed for 2005 to 2015, the venture capital data, especially examined granularly, may provide earlier signals for regulators to identify areas of prospective regulatory need.
